product_choices_G15: Delete: chose "cancel first when people joined" over Reclub's unconditional delete — every player is told (cancel notifies); a finished competition keeps its podium on profiles and is never deleted.
Spectators: chose always auto-approved over Reclub's approve switch — a spectator holds no seat, and a private competition still needs its link.
Free agents without a team become spectators at the start (Reclub's own copy "Free Agents will be moved to Spectators when competition starts") instead of being withdrawn.

Eligibility: chose hkpl's league rule (the level cap is the gate, playing up below the minimum is allowed, an unrated player is flagged when there is a cap) over a strict min–max band; the host's call always wins; WHY is shown to the managers and the team only.
Availability is visible to the match's people (players, referees, managers) only, not to every reader.
Remove match = set aside (cancelled, restorable, out of the standings) rather than a hard delete; bracket matches are never removed.
Score sets: per-match names + Tiebreaker flag instead of competition-wide default set names.
Leave team: a non-captain member leaves the TEAM (the team stays entered with an open place) — the engine used to withdraw the whole team when any member left.
